items.question: Do I need to take a hearing test before buying?
items.answer: No, you do not have to take a hearing test before purchasing. Our hearing aids are developed to work for Americans that suffer from mild to moderate hearing loss.

items.question: Do I need a prescription before purchasing?
items.answer: No. There is no prescription needed for purchasing the Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids. Anyone with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss can order them, as long as they are at least 18 years old.

items.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
items.answer: Our device comes with a 120-Day Money Back Guarantee. If they don't improve your hearing, contact info@nebroo.com within 120 days of receiving the product and we will issue you a refund.
